hero.title: Turn audio into text on your Mac.
hero.lead: Private speech to text for audio and video files. Transcribe, edit, translate, and export locally on your Mac.
hero.webStore: View on the App Store website
hero.requirements: Requires macOS 26+ and the necessary system speech and translation models, installed through System Settings. MP4/MOV support depends on the codecs macOS can decode; protected video or video without an audio track cannot be transcribed.

features.title: From audio queue to translated transcript.
items: Batch conversion
Batch long files with pause and resume. Pause, run another task, then continue nearby.
Pause and resume
Pause a long transcription, handle another item first, then resume near the last finalized segment.
Listen. Correct. Export.
Jump to a sentence, change playback speed, edit original text or translations, and undo changes. Your edits are saved locally and restored when you reopen the app.
Export choices
Proof once and export six formats: TXT, Markdown, HTML, DOCX, SRT, and VTT.

privacy.title: Transcription and translation stay local.
items: App privacy
Sensitive content stays on your Mac. No cloud transcription, accounts, or remote logging.
System models
Language and translation models are managed by macOS System Settings. The app checks model availability but does not download models itself.
Website privacy
This static website does not include analytics scripts, advertising trackers, forms, cookies, or online fonts. Cloudflare may process standard request logs as the hosting provider.

pricing.title: Everything included. No subscription.
pricing.text: The App Store shows the price for your country or region. Download once and use every transcription, translation, and export feature.
pricing.note: OfflineScribe is a paid App Store download. Every feature is included, with no in-app purchases, subscriptions, trials, purchase restoration, or feature unlocking inside the app.

support.title: Questions, reports, and feedback.
support.text: Send conversion issues, language model questions, and workflow feedback directly to the developer.
support.note: Contact is optional. Your message opens in your default mail app, and you control what gets sent.

faq.title: Before you start
items: What can I turn into text?
Turn meeting recordings, interviews, lectures, and voice notes into editable text. Import an audio or video file, review the transcript while listening, and export documents or subtitles.
Can I transcribe offline?

Requires macOS 26+ and the necessary system speech and translation models, installed through System Settings. MP4/MOV support depends on the codecs macOS can decode; protected video or video without an audio track cannot be transcribed.
Is a subscription required?
OfflineScribe is a paid App Store download. Every feature is included, with no in-app purchases, subscriptions, trials, purchase restoration, or feature unlocking inside the app.
